entry.title: Last Call Maduro Flaquitas — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, dark rum (projected)
Occasion: Pre-cut short session, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Dark cocoa, espresso, leather, earth, black pepper, molasses and baking spice give the Last Call Maduro Flaquitas a dense, sweet-spicy Broadleaf profile. The pepper-heavy opening is reported to settle into coffee, cocoa and leather, with cinnamon, nutmeg and brown-sugar sweetness adding complexity through the middle. The 46 ring keeps the Pennsylvania Broadleaf prominent without the oversized feel of thicker AJ Fernandez vitolas, while the long roasted finish can develop some char and bitterness if pushed.

note: Add AJ Fernandez Last Call Maduro Flaquitas as an active long-format candidate using the CAO Flathead V642 Piston card as the structural reference. Cigarworld currently lists the exact 6 x 46 single at A$45.07 with Add to Cart. Represent it under the catalogue's established long-cigar halving convention as two 3-inch sessions at A$22.54 per practical session. Strength 8 and Quality 8 are untasted projections; leave Flavour unrated until personally tasted. AJ Fernandez's official blend specification gives Pennsylvania Broadleaf wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler.
